title: Arcs of constant density and plane on a minimizing 2-cone continue until a density jump (sector lemma)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let C ∈ 𝒟_2(ℝ^P) be minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn C univ), with ∂C = 0 (BoundaryVanishes C) and a cone (IsConeCurrent C). Let Q ⊆ ℝ^P be a 2-dimensional linear subspace, z, e ∈ Q with |z| = |e| = 1 and ⟨z, e⟩ = 0, k ∈ ℕ with k ≥ 1, and L ∈ ℝ; write γ(φ) := cos φ·z + sin φ·e. Assume (i) there is ε > 0 with spt C ∩ B_ε(z) = Q ∩ B_ε(z) and HasMassDensity C y k for every y ∈ spt C ∩ B_ε(z); and (ii) for every φ with 0 < φ < L such that γ(φ) ∈ spt C and HasMassDensity C γ(φ) k, there are δ > 0 and k' ∈ ℕ with HasMassDensity C y k' for every y ∈ spt C ∩ B_δ(γ(φ)). Then for every φ with 0 ≤ φ < L there is ε > 0 with spt C ∩ B_ε(γ(φ)) = Q ∩ B_ε(γ(φ)) and HasMassDensity C y k for every y ∈ spt C ∩ B_ε(γ(φ)).
